label: Claude Haiku 4.5 via the Claude CLI
availabilityDetail: Anthropic execution requires an explicit CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in the runner environment; defaulting to import-only so prepared bundles cannot spend tokens accidentally
invocationNote: As `claude-sonnet`, with `--model haiku`. The smallest model available here, and therefore the one most likely to produce a catch set that is a strict superset of the others — which is what a bank needs to have any width at all.
